documents.title: Little River County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 227 pages. Amounts are the Ordinance 'TOTAL BUDGET' amounts (pp. 5-7) for funds and General Fund offices; category totals from the '2026 Requested Budget' column 'Group Total' rows (pp. 30-92), used only where they add exactly to the ordinance amount (the ordinance adopts the budget dated November 10, 2025 by reference, and its office/fund totals equal that column). column.
